title: Slow and Steady Banana Bread
description: Banana bread made in a slow cooker for an incredibly dense, squidgy texture, then blasted in the oven for a crispy crust. Made with bananas, self-raising flour and condensed milk.

ingredients.text: 1 x 397g tin of sweetened condensed milk

steps: Pour a cup of cold water into the slow cooker and set to high. Grease and line a standard loaf tin.
Mash the bananas in a bowl with a fork.
Sift the flour and fold in the mashed bananas. Pour in the condensed milk and stir until just combined.
Pour batter into the loaf tin. Place the tin inside the slow cooker and cover with a sheet of greaseproof paper. Put the lid on to seal.
Leave for around 2 hours 30 minutes until the loaf has stopped rising but still has a slight wobble.
Remove from slow cooker and blast in a hot oven (240°C/220°C fan) for 10–15 minutes to get a crispy crust.
Allow to cool in the tin, then slice generously.
notes: Serves 8–10. Requires a large slow cooker (at least 3.5 litres) to fit the loaf tin inside.
